files_folder_existing.title: Use an existing folder
files_folder_existing.description: Off: the service gets a new folder of its own, named after it. On: pick a folder already in your file tree; every service set to the same folder sees the same files.

downloads_path.title: Downloads folder
downloads_path.description: Where finished downloads go, inside its files folder.

yolab_enabled.title: YoLab address
yolab_enabled.description: Reachable from anywhere at https://<subdomain>.<your-number>.yolab.io, through your YoLab tunnel. Visitors need IPv6.

webui_password.title: Password
webui_password.description: The password for the user admin, set on every start. Leave it empty to keep the temporary password qBittorrent prints each time it starts.

vpn_enabled.title: Download through Mullvad
vpn_enabled.description: qBittorrent reaches the internet only through a Mullvad VPN, and stops downloading if the VPN is down. Its web page stays on your YoLab address.

files_folder.title: Files folder
files_folder.description: Open a folder to see the folders inside it, then pick one. / is the whole file tree, every service's data included.

vpn_private_key.title: Mullvad WireGuard private key
vpn_private_key.description: From mullvad.net → Account → WireGuard configuration → generate a key, then copy the PrivateKey line.

vpn_addresses.title: Mullvad WireGuard address
vpn_addresses.description: The Address line from the same Mullvad configuration file, e.g. 10.64.123.45/32.

vpn_server_countries.title: VPN server countries
vpn_server_countries.description: Optional. Comma-separated, e.g. Netherlands,Switzerland. Empty lets the VPN pick.

yolab_token.title: YoLab token
yolab_token.description: Leave it as it is to use this box's YoLab account.
